claim: In the matching retail DLL, the two direct Audience helpers called by FACT-0078 are exact method bodies. Audience.TensionDown (0x060047D7) is a parameterless instance method with an exact 50-byte body: it decrements Audience.CheerLevel_Base by raw one, clamps the field to raw -4 only when the decremented value is less than -4, calls Audience.CalcCheerLevel(), then calls Audience.PlayLoopCheerVoice with raw arguments 0 and false, and returns. Audience.PlayCheerVoice (0x060047D9) is an instance method with exact signature blob 20020111aa0008, parameters vid (metadata valuetype token resolving to CheerVoiceEnum) and nLevel:Int32, and an exact 171-byte body. It obtains MatchMain.GetInst(); when isFastForwardMatch is nonzero, Fade.GetInst().IsFadeFinish() is nonzero, and unsigned MchFrameCnt % 20 is nonzero, it returns before playback. Otherwise it stores nLevel, initializes two Float32 locals to raw 0.5f and 1.0f, and tests AttendanceRate against raw 0.0f with bne.un. Only an ordered-equal-zero value takes the zero-local path; all unequal or unordered values take the arithmetic path. That path performs the emitted Float32 sequence low = low - (1.0f - AttendanceRate) * 0.2f and high = high - (1.0f - AttendanceRate) * 0.5f. It then computes local = low + (high - low) * (Float32(nLevel) / 4.0f), multiplies local by raw 1.0f, and calls Menu_SoundManager.Play_CheerVoice_OneShot(vid,local). FACT-0078 pins the calls to PlayCheerVoice with raw arguments 9 and 0 and to TensionDown with no arguments.
